verdict.rationale: Morph's docs say to point any OpenAI SDK at https://api.morphllm.com/v1 with one API key. They add that existing OpenAI code needs only a new model string, and llms.txt states the API is OpenAI-compatible. A community user independently got the OpenAI-compatible endpoint working with their own CLI tool. missing for 10: an explicit code snippet showing only base_url and api_key changed in an SDK client, and a documented list of which OpenAI endpoint parameters are or are not supported.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point an existing OpenAI SDK client at the provider by changing only the base URL and API key

citations.quote: Point any OpenAI SDK at https://api.morphllm.com/v1. One API key covers the open-weight chat models and the specialized tools
